notes.title: Ver 0.4.101 Update
notes.content:
Update:

More stages are WIP!

notes.title: Ver 0.3.221 adjustment
notes.content:
Ver 0.3.221

Adjustment:
- Supplementary tips for Flandre mini-games
- Added Cirno's back dash animation
- Added default keys for ui keys (arrow key direction, enter key to confirm, ESC key to cancel)

Bug fixes:
- Fixed the display error of some characters in English

notes.title: Experience optimization
notes.content:
Ver0.3.217

Mechanism adjustment:
- Now stand up will get recover.
- Death option [Retreat] replaced with [Check Status]
- You can choose to go home directly from the status bar
- No longer attacked while talking

Bug fixes:
- Fixed the bug that the character would move when operating some UI pages

tags.feature: - Now stand up will get recover.
- You can choose to go home directly from the status bar

notes.title: Jump adjustment
notes.content:
Version 0.3.152

- Now when the jump button is released, it will stop ascending and can make small jumps

Bug fixes:
- Fixed the bug that the bell sometimes ran out of the room
- Fixed a bug where you could play throwing knives with your back to Sakuya
